_comment: Merge this `hooks` block into your project's .claude/settings.local.json (keep your existing permissions). Adjust the two absolute paths to your organism.py and your results dir. SessionStart injects laws+health into context; Stop self-checks + flags undigested results. Takes effect next session; manage via /hooks.

hooks.command: out=$(python3 /ABS/PATH/TO/organism.py --hook-stop /ABS/PATH/TO/results 2>/dev/null); echo "$out" | grep -qE 'ORPHAN|REVIEW' && echo "$out" | jq -Rs '{systemMessage:.}' 2>/dev/null || true
